Senses.PreferredTarget: where you stand is all genuine
AlternateTargets: the place you take is entirely real
Senses.Explanation: Literally, at the place of standing or taking one's position (立處), all is genuine or real (皆真): "where you stand is all genuine." It occurs 35 times in 24 allowlisted texts. Linji's record supplies the governing formula twice: "act as host wherever you are; where you stand is all genuine; arriving circumstances cannot turn you around" (隨處作主，立處皆真，境來回換不得). The second passage precedes it with "do not receive another person's delusion" and follows it by warning that a single doubtful thought gives an opening. Jingtu Huimin reverses its paired order as "where you stand is all genuine; act as host according to the place" (立處皆真，隨方作主). Zhongyan Huayan Zujue attaches it to "take it up and immediately use it" (拈來便用), while Zhenjing Kewen explicitly quotes Linji's wording as "bring it and immediately use it; where you stand is all genuine" (把來便用，立處皆真). Chan bends the ordinary idea of a standing-place into a stable Linji roster phrase about taking the host position amid changing circumstances; the entry reports the formula and its transmitted predicates without adding a claim beyond those recorded predicates.
Senses.Note: The variant "where you stand is immediately genuine" (立處即真) occurs 19 times in 15 texts. Dahui Zonggao uses it in his own recorded sayings, so the wording is shared beyond Linji quotations and no master-specific SenseKey is needed.

Occurrences.Kwic: 爾且隨處作主，立處皆真，境來回換不得
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Linji Huizhao of Zhenzhou (鎮州臨濟慧照禪師語錄). Linji Yixuan gives the central three-part formula.

Occurrences.Kwic: 直要不受人惑，隨處作主，立處皆真，但有來者皆不得受。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Linji Huizhao of Zhenzhou (鎮州臨濟慧照禪師語錄). Linji Yixuan's second formulation foregrounds not receiving another person's delusion.

Occurrences.Kwic: 道無動靜法本隨緣。立處皆真隨方作主。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Continued Record of the Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), section on Jingtu Huimin. Jingtu Huimin reverses the order of the paired clauses.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若能取捨俱忘，觸目無滯，拈來便用，立處皆真
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Jiatai Universal Lamp Record (嘉泰普燈錄), section on Zhongyan Huayan Zujue. Zhongyan Huayan Zujue pairs the phrase with taking up and immediately using.

Occurrences.Kwic: 我這裏是活祖師西來意，把來便用，立處皆真。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Jiatai Universal Lamp Record (嘉泰普燈錄), section on Zhenjing Kewen. Zhenjing Kewen explicitly introduces the wording as Linji's saying and pairs it with immediate use.

Occurrences.Kwic: 非離真而立處。立處即真。所謂胸襟流出蓋天蓋地者如是而已。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dahui Pujue (大慧普覺禪師語錄). Dahui Zonggao uses the variant ‘where you stand is immediately genuine’ (立處即真) while discussing words that issue from one's own breast.
